title: Independent second check of repaired Reading the Landscape headings
scope: Read-only semantic check against exact English slide headings. This is not fluent-speaker approval.

entries.exactSourceEnglish: Watch: See Wind and Cold Air on the Map
entries.candidate: Shebella: See Wind and Cold Air on the Map
entries.reason: Shebella preserves the source directive Watch; the English remainder preserves the complete wind/cold-air/map relation, including on the map.

entries.exactSourceEnglish: Let Plants Help You Read Soil
entries.candidate: Lumella dimela di u thuse ho bala Soil
entries.reason: Lumella keeps the let/allow directive; dimela remains the subject and u the second-person object. ho bala Soil retains the soil-reading action and its technical English anchor. The u form is consistent with Southern Sesotho rather than the flagged go form.

entries.exactSourceEnglish: Let Plants Help You Read Soil
entries.candidate: Tendelani zwilimela zwi ni thuse u read Soil
entries.verdict: directive meaning preserved; conservative unreviewed mixed draft
entries.reason: Tendelani supplies an imperative allow/let frame, with plants as the subject of help and ni as the addressee. The English read Soil technical anchor is explicitly permitted; no shift to can/may or loss of the directive is apparent. A fluent Tshivenda reviewer should still check idiom and agreement.

entries.exactSourceEnglish: Let Plants Help You Read Soil
entries.candidate: Pfumelela swimilani swi ku pfuna ku read Soil
entries.verdict: directive meaning preserved; conservative unreviewed mixed draft
entries.reason: Pfumelela supplies the imperative allow/let frame, keeping plants as the subject that helps the addressee. ku read Soil retains the source action with its difficult English technical anchor; no shift from directive to possibility is apparent. A fluent Xitsonga reviewer should still check idiom and agreement.

overall: No concrete semantic repair is indicated for these four proposed headings. Keep their unreviewed-draft marking and facilitator review.
